outputs.explanation: Spatial expression plots overlaid on tissue sections showing per-spot log2 expression heatmaps; these are spatial heatmap-type visualizations, not averaged bar/summary plots, so individual data point overlay is not applicable.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrograph images only; no averaged/summary plot is shown, so the check does not apply.

Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing TMPRSS11B expression for each individual LUAD and LUSC tumor sample (n=512, n=500), with median and 95% CI overlaid; individual data points are already displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with individual data points (n=3 technical replicates per group) overlaid as dots for each condition, satisfying the requirement.
